Description:
First time posting so forgive me if things are a little rough or if there is a better place to ask. I'm looking for a dark aesthetic fairy that I can use as a boss enemy. I can work with generator parts too. If wings, then something that's a bit different than MV default fairy wings. The ideal aesthetic I'm looking for is something similar to Triandra from Fire Emblem.
Reference Images:
(Admittedly, I don't know if any of her art is post-able here, so I'm just going to link to her wiki page instead)
https://fireemblemwiki.org/wiki/Triandra

posts.body:
Those are default fairy wings from the RTP fairy, but not the one from the generator, Hiddeone has these.
Those should work well and you can recolor them as you like.
